P1.reason: B separates board updating from legal dropping and landing; A's two drop groups nearly duplicate each other, and its win group repeats the diagonal lines.

differences.reason: Hurts: almost a copy of A3, mixing legality, landing, cell updates and setup into one blob.
Hurts slightly: a full win/end rule, but it repeats the horizontal and diagonal lines already in C1.
Hurts: a superset of A1 that adds below and noop, so the two groups say much the same thing.
Helps: a clean board-state rule, holding the cell updates and the starting empty grid.
Helps: the end and win rule, without repeating the diagonals that C1 already holds.
Helps: the drop rule with legality, landing and gravity, plus noop; it overlaps B1 only a little.
